significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the form-(ii) causal conclusion that “a few attention heads write an ‘uncertainty/keep-checking’ direction,” reflection-token computations read it, and the resulting tokens re-trigger the same heads; because this fixes the write→read→re-trigger order of a feedback circuit, it constrains explanations of when redundant verification persists rather than merely showing a decodable direction. This would establish both a token-level phenomenon and a compact mechanism relevant to budget-control approaches such as Muennighoff et al.’s s1: Simple Test-Time Scaling (2025), although its direct causal consequence remains bounded to overthinking rather than multiple reasoning failures. True and false are distinguishable: a negative result would rule out the stated compact feedback-circuit account, but would not by itself select among distributed, MLP-mediated, or decoding-level alternatives. Topic substitution fails—the generic topic of mechanistic efficient reasoning would not supply this specific cyclic ordering—so the score reflects the claim rather than the topic.

reach.justification: The named handle is a decoding-time intervention that “attenuates this specific read path” by “masking or down-weighting the identified heads’ contribution only at reflection-token query positions”; it is ex ante with respect to the next redundant verification segment and therefore leaves an action window to shorten generation. After per-model re-localization, the hypothesis predicts the same qualitative write→reflection-read→re-trigger organization, but it supplies neither transferable head identities nor a quantitative relation predicting a new model’s effect size. The asserted scope covers reasoning models and several reasoning-task classes, with potential uptake by researchers and practitioners able to modify model internals, though not ordinary API-only deployers. Topic substitution again fails because the generic topic alone provides neither this path-specific intervention nor its online trigger.
